lang.title: Choose your language
lang.intro: The whole study will use the language you choose.
common.deviceTooSmall.title: Please use a bigger screen
common.deviceTooSmall.body: This study needs a tablet held sideways, a laptop or a computer. Please open this link on one of those.
study.title: Grocery shopping study
study.invalidLink.title: This link does not work
study.invalidLink.body: Please check that you copied the whole link from your invitation, or contact the research team.
study.error.title: Something went wrong
study.error.body: Your answers so far are saved. Please reload the page to continue.
study.notReady.title: The study is not open yet
study.notReady.body: Thank you for your interest. This study has not started yet. Please contact the person who sent you this link.
consent.heading: Your consent
consent.instruction: If you agree, please tick all three boxes.
consent.check.read: I have read and understood the information
consent.mustAgree: Please tick all three boxes to continue.
consent.reconfirm.title: Before we start: please confirm again
consent.reconfirm.body: This is the same information you read in the first session. Please read it again, and tick the boxes if you still agree to take part.
bg.title: About you
bg.intro: A few short questions about you. There are no right or wrong answers.
bg.csOrIt: Do you study or work in computer science, software or IT?
bg.techConfidence: How confident are you using a computer, tablet or phone?
bg.smartphoneUse: How often do you use a smartphone?
bg.computerUse: How often do you use a computer or tablet?
bg.shopping: How often do you shop online?
bg.shopping.weekly: About once a week or more
bg.groceriesOnline: Have you ever bought groceries online?
bg.readingGlasses: Do you use reading glasses when using a screen?
bg.readingLanguage: Which language are you most comfortable reading?
bg.prefsTitle: What you like on shopping websites
bg.prefsIntro: For each question, choose the picture you would prefer, or "No preference".
eligibility.title: Thank you for your interest
eligibility.body: This study is for adults aged {minAge} or over, so we cannot include you this time. Thank you very much for your time. You can now close this page.
instr.title: How this works
instr.step1: You will see two short videos of a grocery shop changing its look.
instr.step2: Both videos play at the same time. They last a few seconds.
instr.step3: When they have finished, choose the shop you would rather use: Option A or Option B.
instr.step4: You can watch the videos again as often as you like.
instr.step5: There are no right or wrong answers.
instr.duration: The session takes about {minutes} minutes, including two short breaks.
mainIntro.title: Practice complete
mainIntro.body: Now the real comparisons begin. There are {count} comparisons, with {breaks} short breaks.
trial.question: Which shop would you rather use?
trial.questionChooseB: For this one, please choose Option B.
trial.watchFirst: Please watch both videos to the end, then choose.
trial.keyboardHint: Keyboard: ← for Option A, → for Option B
trial.keyboardHintRtl: Keyboard: → for Option A, ← for Option B
trial.videoError: A video could not be loaded.
break.title: Time for a short break
break.body: You have finished {done} of {total} comparisons. Rest your eyes for a moment. Continue when you are ready.
end.title: Thank you!
end.comparison: You have finished the first session. We will contact you to arrange the second session.
end.shopping: You have finished the study. Thank you very much for taking part.
end.code: Your participant code (keep it if you might want to withdraw your data later):
end.close: You can now close this page.
shop.hint.list: Tap “Add” to put an item in your basket.
shop.hint.basket: Your basket shows what you chose and the total.
shop.hint.search: Type a product name to find it quickly.
task.title: Your task
task.confirmBody: You cannot come back to this shop afterwards.
sb.locked.title: Welcome
sb.locked.body: The researcher will start the session in a moment. Please wait.
sb.welcome.title: Welcome to the second session
sb.welcome.p1: You will do four short shopping tasks in an online grocery shop.
sb.welcome.p2: Each task has a shopping list and a budget.
sb.welcome.p3: The shop may change its look while you use it. Just carry on shopping as you normally would.
sb.welcome.p4: After each task, you will answer a few questions. At the end, you will compare the four shops.
sb.welcome.p5: First, there is a short practice task. It does not count.
q.progress: Questions about the shop in task {number}
q.missing: Please answer all questions. {count} still need an answer.
rank.title: Compare the four shops
rank.intro: These are the four shops you used, in the order you used them. Put them in order, from the one you liked most at the top to the one you liked least at the bottom. Drag a shop, or use the arrow buttons.
home.body: Please use the personal link you received to take part.
